description: Real-weather ETEX-1 mini run from ERA5 native model levels. GPU uses 16 AGL levels with omega-derived w; Oracle uses 137 hybrid levels with etadot.

wind.note: Derived from ERA5 native model levels via scripts/etex/prepare_native_era5.py

candidate_philox.derivation: seed i uses key [base0 + i, base1] with zeroed counter

representation_differences.vertical_coordinate: GPU: 16 fixed AGL levels (10-20000m); Oracle: 137 native hybrid model levels.
representation_differences.horizontal_grid: Both 0.25 deg, but GPU uses regular lat/lon; Oracle uses rotated grid.
representation_differences.temporal_resolution: GPU: 180s fixed timestep; Oracle: adaptive timestep per FLEXPART.
representation_differences.wind_components: GPU: omega-derived w (pressure velocity -> m/s); Oracle: native etadot (eta-coordinate velocity).
representation_differences.pbl_diagnostics: GPU: computed from interpolated surface fields; Oracle: native PBL scheme.
notes: These are structural representation differences, not errors.

Domain containment waived: the declared placeholder domain and release geometry predate input-equivalence work (see representation_differences); containment is enforced for all synthetic corpus cases.
